definitions.gloss: empty seat; vacant seat; unoccupied seat
definitions.explanation: A seat that is not occupied, available for use.
Figuratively, an unfilled position or opening, such as in an organization or committee.

examples.english: Please sit down if you find an empty seat.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{空|くう}→空〜：03949_kuu⟧ (empty, vacant) + ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空席|くうせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ - there is an empty seat
- {空席|くうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ - to look for an empty seat
- {空席|くうせき}{待|ま}ち - waiting for a seat/vacancy
- {空席|くうせき}⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ - seat availability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧ - fully booked, no seats available

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{空|あ}き→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ - empty seat (same meaning, different reading)
- ⟦{空|あ}き→空く：11062_aku⟧ - vacancy, opening
- ⟦{欠員|けついん}→欠員：14787_ketsuin⟧ - vacancy (in personnel)
